title: Evaluating Text Classifiers
learning_objectives: Report per-class precision, recall and F1 with classification_report
Read a confusion matrix for several classes
Collect misclassified examples for error analysis
hints: Check that the three lengths match.
`report = classification_report(y_true, y_pred, labels=labels, output_dict=True, zero_division=0)`; per-class entries are keyed by `str(label)`.
Errors: `[(t, a, b) for t, a, b in zip(texts, y_true, y_pred) if a != b]`.

failure_feedback.advice: Rows of the confusion matrix are true labels, columns predicted, in the given label order.
Read precision, recall, f1-score and support from classification_report(output_dict=True).
Keep (text, true, predicted) for mismatches in input order.
All three sequences must have the same length.
